title: Garrett_Baxley_Resume_Designed
universal_lens: The sovereign primitive of organizational state-transition is modeled as a non-linear mapping from reactive ambiguity to performance-driven equilibrium. By defining workforce dynamics through high-dimensional compliance and safety constraints, the system minimizes entropy across multi-employer joint ventures, establishing a rigorous mathematical unification of human capital optimization under extreme operational pressure. A unified framework for sovereign intelligence primitives integrating data stack, organizational architecture, and probabilistic inference across domains.
gsi_mapping: GSI applies Bayesian hierarchical modeling to infer latent leadership efficacy from sparse, high-stakes incident data. Conformal prediction intervals bound the uncertainty of workforce scaling across four distinct trade-partner organizations, ensuring that real-time visibility into OSHA recordables and man-hours yields statistically robust priors for future megaproject staffing and safety interventions. Bayesian belief propagation over structured data pipelines enables real-time inference of operational states and predictive outcomes within GSI's probabilistic architecture.
gse_mapping: GSE maps the standalone megaproject HR function as a dynamic Markov Decision Process. State transitions occur between reactive workplace environments and performance-driven cultures, governed by reward functions tied to schedule adherence and safety compliance. The operator navigates overlapping OCIP systems, optimizing policy gradients to align onsite execution with enterprise strategy. Situationally adaptive state transitions in GSE are governed by dynamic policy kernels derived from multi-source telemetry and constrained optimization of resource allocation.

primitives.name: Reactive-to-Performance Culture Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equal parts strategic partner and operator — trusted to navigate ambiguity, align executive and external stakeholders, and turn reactive environments into performance-driven cultures.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: Organizational culture state vector (dimensionless), A: Ambiguity index (0 to 1), S: Stakeholder alignment scalar (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes stakeholder alignment acts as a linear constraint on cultural entropy; assumes leadership intervention provides sufficient gradient descent to overcome local minima in reactive states.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when ambiguity index A approaches 1.0 without corresponding increases in decision authority, leading to systemic paralysis and irreversible cultural decay.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE policy optimization where an agent transitions a chaotic environment into a stable, high-reward regime via continuous feedback loops.
layer2.telemetry: Employee engagement scores, reduction in reactive incident reports, and executive satisfaction metrics.

primitives.name: Megaproject Workforce Scaling Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Most recently the sole HR leader for a $2.5B+ hyperscale data center program — standing up the entire HR, safety, and compliance operation for a four-company joint venture and its 4,600+ peak workforce, and serving as primary people advisor to project executives and partner-firm leadership.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: N: Peak workforce size (dimensionless count), V: Program valuation ($), J: Number of joint venture entities (integer)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes linear scalability of HR infrastructure relative to workforce N up to a critical threshold; assumes resource allocation is perfectly fungible across J entities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when N exceeds the cognitive bandwidth of a single operator without automated telemetry, causing compliance latency and safety failures.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI conformal inference for scaling sports rosters or fanbases under massive budget constraints, predicting failure points in support infrastructure.
layer2.telemetry: Onboarding latency rates, compliance violation counts per 1,000 workers, and cross-entity communication delays.

primitives.name: Analytic Visibility & Forecasting Tensor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Strong across organizational design, workforce planning, change management, and employee relations, backed by the analytics, forecasting models, and systems that give leaders real visibility into their workforce.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: V: Visibility metric (information entropy, bits), F: Forecasting accuracy (RMSE, dimensionless), T: Time horizon (hours/days)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes data collection systems are noise-free and that historical workforce patterns reliably predict future scheduling requirements under stochastic demand.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Model collapse occurs during black swan events (e.g., pandemics, mass exoduses) where historical priors become entirely invalid, rendering forecasts useless.

layer2.mapping: Directly isomorphic to GSI player tracking and injury forecasting tensors, providing coaches with real-time visibility into roster health and availability.
layer2.telemetry: Dashboard utilization rates, forecast vs. actual man-hour variance, and time-to-decision for leadership.

primitives.name: Ground-Up Operating Model Constructor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Built the program's HR operating model from the ground up — workforce onboarding, safety badging, and compliance intake — standardizing jobsite entry for every worker across all four trade-partner organizations.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: M: Operating model complexity (number of standardized protocols), E: Entry standardization rate (%), W: Total unique workers (count)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a unified protocol M can be successfully imposed across disparate corporate cultures without significant resistance or adaptation lag.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if trade-partner organizations possess mutually exclusive legacy compliance systems that cannot be abstracted into a single standardized intake pipeline.

layer2.mapping: Derives the GSE kernel for drafting and integrating free agents into a new team system, standardizing playbooks across diverse player backgrounds.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of workers onboarded within SLA, reduction in safety badging errors, and cross-organizational audit pass rates.

primitives.name: Data Stack Sovereignty
primitives.verbatim_quote: Own the full stack: data engineering, predictive modeling, and product architecture (Next.js · Prisma · PostgreSQL).
primitives.assumptions: The data stack operates as a closed-loop system with deterministic transformation rules and probabilistic inference layers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure of any component in the stack leads to cascading degradation of downstream predictive models.

layer2.mapping: The data stack is isomorphic to a Bayesian network where each layer represents a conditional probability distribution over data states.
layer2.telemetry: Pipeline throughput, latency, and error rate metrics.

primitives.name: Organizational Architecture Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Designed the data model, multi-vendor architecture, and brand system end to end.
primitives.assumptions: Organizational structure is modeled as a directed acyclic graph with nodes representing roles and edges representing information flow.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of central coordination leads to emergent inefficiencies in cross-functional alignment.

layer2.mapping: The kernel maps organizational roles to functional modules in GSE's decision-making architecture.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-departmental collaboration score, decision latency, and policy adherence rate.

primitives.name: HR Compliance Infrastructure
primitives.verbatim_quote: Led HR through two acquisitions (TX + GA) and multi-state compliance (TX · GA · FL · LA · MS · AL) across FMLA, ADA, and EEOC — building scalable HR infrastructure and the company-wide handbook.
primitives.assumptions: Compliance systems operate under a set of regulatory constraints that define valid organizational behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-compliance in one jurisdiction triggers cascading legal and financial penalties.

layer2.mapping: The HR compliance framework mirrors a constraint satisfaction problem in GSE's governance layer.
layer2.telemetry: Regulatory audit score, incident reporting frequency, and compliance training completion rate.

primitives.name: Performance Optimization Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: Lifted eNPS by 46 points, cut time-to-hire by 80%, reduced employee-relations issues by 50%, and improved leadership effectiveness by 60% through coaching, training, and performance-management programs.
primitives.assumptions: Performance improvement follows a stochastic process with diminishing returns and bounded convergence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Over-optimization leads to burnout and attrition, reducing long-term gains.

layer2.mapping: The engine is a derived kernel from GSI's behavioral modeling layer, mapping human capital metrics to organizational resilience.
layer2.telemetry: Employee engagement index, retention rate, and leadership maturity score.
